# The Ambergris Company

## Overview

Holds the quay, the counting house, and the survey contract the crew signed.

## Background

Says it has never surveyed the marsh. [[Old Bellwether]] says otherwise, and
[[Ferrant Oake]] says the accord is older than the Company admits.

## The Contract (Session 3)

Paid forty marks each in advance for a survey it would not explain.

## Connections

- [[Ferrant Oake]]
- [[Tallow Quay]]
- [[The Silt Accord]]
- [[Halvern Reach]]

## Notes

Two independent contradictions of the Company's own account, from people who have not
met each other.
